import pytest

import click.shell_completion
from click.core import Argument
from click.core import Command
from click.core import Group
from click.shell_completion import add_completion_class
from click.shell_completion import BashComplete
from click.shell_completion import CompletionItem
from click.shell_completion import FishComplete
from click.shell_completion import get_completion_class
from click.shell_completion import PowerShellComplete
from click.shell_completion import ShellComplete
from click.shell_completion import ZshComplete


def _items_cli(make_items):
    """A command whose only argument completes to exactly the items
    produced by ``make_items()`` (fresh objects on every call)."""

    def _complete(ctx, param, incomplete):
        return make_items()

    return Command("cli", params=[Argument(["x"], shell_complete=_complete)])


def _make_cls(**attrs):
    class _C(ShellComplete):
        name = "x"
        source_template = ""

        def get_completion_args(self):
            return [], ""

        def format_completion(self, item):
            return f"{item.type},{item.value}"

    for key, value in attrs.items():
        setattr(_C, key, value)

    return _C


def _complete(cls, cli, args=None, incomplete=""):
    comp = cls(cli, {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE")
    return comp.get_completions([] if args is None else args, incomplete)


def _triples(items):
    return [(i.value, i.type, i.help) for i in items]


def _mixed_items():
    return [
        CompletionItem("b", help="hb"),
        CompletionItem("a"),
        CompletionItem("b", help="other"),
        CompletionItem("C", type="file"),
        CompletionItem("a", help="ha"),
        CompletionItem("c"),
    ]


def _chain_cli():
    # Completing ["get"] yields "set" from the "get" subgroup and again
    # "set" from the chained parent's siblings.
    return Group(
        "cli",
        chain=True,
        commands=[
            Command("set"),
            Command("start"),
            Group("get", commands=[Command("set")]),
        ],
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def _restore_available_shells():
    prev = click.shell_completion._available_shells.copy()
    yield
    click.shell_completion._available_shells.clear()
    click.shell_completion._available_shells.update(prev)


# 1. defaults unchanged


def test_default_class_attributes():
    assert ShellComplete.dedupe_completions is False
    assert ShellComplete.sort_completions is False
    assert ShellComplete.max_completions is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "cls", [BashComplete, ZshComplete, FishComplete, PowerShellComplete]
)
def test_builtin_shells_defaults_leave_output_unchanged(cls):
    assert cls.dedupe_completions is False
    assert cls.sort_completions is False
    assert cls.max_completions is None
    cli = _items_cli(_mixed_items)
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == _triples(_mixed_items())


def test_defaults_keep_chain_duplicates():
    cli = _chain_cli()
    words = [i.value for i in _complete(ShellComplete, cli, ["get"])]
    assert words == ["set", "set", "start"]


def test_defaults_complete_output_unchanged():
    cls = _make_cls()
    cli = _items_cli(_mixed_items)
    out = cls(cli, {}, "cli", "_CLI_COMPLETE").complete()
    assert out == "plain,b\nplain,a\nplain,b\nfile,C\nplain,a\nplain,c"


# 2. dedupe keeps first position and fills missing help


def test_dedupe_keeps_first_position():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("b", help="hb"),
            CompletionItem("a", help="ha"),
            CompletionItem("b", help="other"),
            CompletionItem("c"),
            CompletionItem("a", help="x"),
        ]
    )
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [
        ("b", "plain", "hb"),
        ("a", "plain", "ha"),
        ("c", "plain", None),
    ]


def test_dedupe_fills_missing_help_from_later_duplicate():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("a"),
            CompletionItem("b", help=""),
            CompletionItem("z"),
            CompletionItem("a", help="help a"),
            CompletionItem("b", help="help b"),
        ]
    )
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [
        ("a", "plain", "help a"),
        ("b", "plain", "help b"),
        ("z", "plain", None),
    ]


def test_dedupe_does_not_overwrite_existing_help():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem("a", help="first"), CompletionItem("a", help="2nd")]
    )
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [("a", "plain", "first")]


def test_dedupe_exact_case_comparison():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem("a"), CompletionItem("A"), CompletionItem("a")]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == ["a", "A"]


def test_dedupe_chain_group_sibling_appears_once():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True)
    words = [i.value for i in _complete(cls, _chain_cli(), ["get"])]
    assert words == ["set", "start"]
    assert len(words) == len(set(words))


# 3. sort is casefold stable


def test_sort_casefold():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem("Delta"), CompletionItem("alpha"), CompletionItem("Charlie"), CompletionItem("bravo")]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == [
        "alpha",
        "bravo",
        "Charlie",
        "Delta",
    ]


def test_sort_is_stable_for_case_ties():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("b", help="1"),
            CompletionItem("B", help="2"),
            CompletionItem("A", help="3"),
            CompletionItem("a", help="4"),
        ]
    )
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [
        ("A", "plain", "3"),
        ("a", "plain", "4"),
        ("b", "plain", "1"),
        ("B", "plain", "2"),
    ]


def test_sort_is_stable_for_equal_values():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("z"),
            CompletionItem("m", type="file"),
            CompletionItem("m", type="plain"),
            CompletionItem("m", type="dir"),
        ]
    )
    assert [(i.value, i.type) for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == [
        ("m", "file"),
        ("m", "plain"),
        ("m", "dir"),
        ("z", "plain"),
    ]


def test_sort_uses_str_of_value():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem(9), CompletionItem(10), CompletionItem(2)]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == [10, 2, 9]


def test_dedupe_then_sort_case_variants_adjacent():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True, sort_completions=True)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("b"),
            CompletionItem("A"),
            CompletionItem("B"),
            CompletionItem("a"),
            CompletionItem("b"),
        ]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == ["A", "a", "b", "B"]


# 4. truncate after sort and dedupe


def test_spec_example_sort_and_truncate():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True, max_completions=2)
    cli = Group("cli", commands=[Command("b"), Command("a"), Command("c")])
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == ["a", "b"]


def test_truncate_without_sort_keeps_first_items():
    cls = _make_cls(max_completions=2)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem("z"), CompletionItem("a"), CompletionItem("m")]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == ["z", "a"]


def test_truncate_after_sort_keeps_alphabetically_first():
    cls = _make_cls(sort_completions=True, max_completions=2)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [CompletionItem("z"), CompletionItem("m"), CompletionItem("a")]
    )
    assert [i.value for i in _complete(cls, cli)] == ["a", "m"]


def test_duplicates_do_not_consume_quota():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True, max_completions=2)
    cli = _items_cli(
        lambda: [
            CompletionItem("x"),
            CompletionItem("x", help="hx"),
            CompletionItem("x"),
            CompletionItem("y"),
            CompletionItem("z"),
        ]
    )
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [
        ("x", "plain", "hx"),
        ("y", "plain", None),
    ]


def test_full_pipeline_order():
    cls = _make_cls(dedupe_completions=True, sort_completions=True, max_completions=3)
    cli = _items_cli(_mixed_items)
    # dedupe -> b(hb), a(ha), C(file), c ; sort -> a, b, C, c ; truncate 3
    assert _triples(_complete(cls, cli)) == [
        ("a", "plain", "ha"),
        ("b", "plain", "hb"),
        ("C", "file", None),
    ]
